review.notes: Triage review: all 33 physical pages machine-scanned (no code fences; normalized 4-gram page-text containment vs OCR, mean 0.95; per-word presence check; spaced-digit and escape pattern scan). The only low-containment pages, 26-27, were inspected line-by-line: the divergent text is Figure 6 chart-axis language codes (figure embedded as images with caption) and the printed Crossmodal-3600 appendix table, which OCR captured completely as HTML with every language row present. The printed ICLR running header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2023' is consistently absent from OCR (running headers, not body content). Remaining flagged tokens are Markdown \_ escapes that render as the printed underscores (big_vision, alt_text, extra_id_k). No transcription defects found; no patches.
